method: Visual labels of solid-surface interiors on the assembled v7 ground. These polygons were not read from mask-annotations.json or used to construct the production masks. Conservative exclusion interiors only: this is a leakage LOWER BOUND, not a complete semantic segmentation.
coordinates: Local native 2x pixels, origin at maskRectPx top-left. Vertices refer to the ground image, not the generated animation.

regions.label: snow-capped faceted solid spire, central foreground
solid face left of central spire, below snow cap
snow-covered tree branch, upper diagonal foreground
snow-covered diagonal branch in front of the water
faceted blue solid foreground spire, left interior
solid foreground face to the right of tall grey spire
faceted snow-capped solid spire in front of falling water; left face interior

limitations: Painted blue ice and water can be ambiguous. Labels deliberately avoid boundary pixels, foam and spray.
An unlabelled pixel is not asserted to be liquid. Zero counted exclusions does not establish zero leakage.
This is a second visual review by the current agent, not an independent human review.
